answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5833 Country: India Title: I have problem of drops (not thick like semen) after urination, which lasts for around 30 minutes. What should I do regarding my prayers. Question: I have problem of drops (not thick like semen) after urination, which lasts for around 30 minutes. What should I do regarding my prayers. Answer ID: 5833 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1240/910=H/1429) After 30 minutes when you are sure that the drops have stopped, make ablution and perform salah though you have to miss the jamat in the waiting. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
